To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the polarization of a light beam can be used to encode information; 2) that information can be processed by passive all-optical devices; 3) the resulting polarization-encoded information can be decoded into a light intensity signal; and 4) the intensity signal can be processed in turn by active electronic devices.

the passive all-opticals are capable of performing all the basic operations of the electronic ones and that they are faster, consume much less power, and are more reliable than the microelectronic devices.
we developed a new all-optical technology that is capable of implementing all the essential components of microelectronic digital systems, including logic gates, memory cells, and sequential devices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of all-optical polarization devices and circuits, which are passive and operate at speeds above 10 GHz.

the design of all-optical polarization devices that perform the functions of microelectronic ones, but at much higher speeds, without power sources, and with the four characteristics of microelectronic devices.
the design of passive all-optical devices and systems that can be used for the processing of optical information.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
all-optical digital devices are feasible and are a reality.
the presented all-optical polarization devices are the microelectronic digital processor equivalents.
all-optical polarization devices are a viable technology for the implementation of digital logic and digital processors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the polarization of a light beam can be modulated by light and that such modulated light is used to perform digital operations.
the all-optical polarization technology is now ready for the development of the first all-optical polarization processor.
the all-optical polarization devices can replace the microelectronic digital devices in many applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
all-optical polarization devices are the first step toward the realization of a new generation of optical processors.
the all-optical polarization technology is not only a good alternative to the microelectronics, but it can be used in parallel to the microelectronics in a complementary fashion.
the optical polarization is a very useful and versatile degree of freedom that can be used to design all-optical devices with the same functionality as those of the microelectronics.
